call.t: D-STORM FSTP Call 1 - Loitering Munitions & UCAS: Use Cases, Scenarios and CONOPS
rs: This call is run by its organiser, who sets the eligibility rules. Check the call page.
call.x: Provide first-hand or well-substantiated operational insights and lessons learned on Loitering Munitions and UCAS, particularly from the Ukrainian conflict. Contributions include structured recommendations, questionnaires, interviews and participation in a D-STORM workshop. These inputs will inform the consortium's work on use cases, scenarios, concepts of operations (CONOPS) and high-level requirements.
n: Defence calls also apply rules on control by non-associated third countries. Check the call document.
This is a call run by an EU-funded project (financial support to third parties), not by the Commission. The organiser sets the rules.

HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
